title: Amethyst Block to Shards
description: Just a simple data pack to recover or gain amethyst shards from amethyst blocks. I tried some but they didn't work so I made one.
body:
Just a simple data pack that I made to convert amethyst blocks into shards, I tried some mods that allegedly did this but for some reason they didn't work so I made this data pack.

Installation:

No expert here so I'll just write what I did.

Copy/paste the zip file into your minecraft "data" folder and into your save "datapacks" folder

If you want more check my other datapack [Logical Recipes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/logical-recipes-by-lopachondo)

Enjoy and not needed but if you wish to support me look up my link :)
